content: Given a sequence of words $\left\lbrace w_t\right\rbrace _{t=1}^{T}$ we aim to learn the words hidden state $\left\lbrace h_t\right\rbrace _{t=1}^{T}$ in a way that each word captures the influence of its past and future words. The Bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM) proposed in BIBREF40 is an LSTM that “reads” a sentence, or any sequence in general, from the beginning to the end (forward) and the other way around (backward).
